note: Every visible or audible thing in film.mp4 is listed here. Nothing is fetched from the web; no image or sound file from anyone else is used.

assets.what: the PAELEO threshold score (dog's decision trace, 768 frames)
assets.operation: read by build/solve.ts; the dog's x, act channels (lie, crouch, head, ear, tail, wag, rest, look) and the person's circumstances drive the manifest

assets.what: dog proportions (neck height 0.881 L, chest 0.475 L, tail root 0.76 L, nose-neck 0.706 L, neck-chest 0.425 L; L = chest-tail)
assets.operation: measured: medians of 10 rig keys, normalised; no pixel of the footage is shown

assets.what: the dog: joint graph of tapered capsules + 2 ear triangles (build/src/lib/dogRig.ts), drawn by <Dog> (build/src/comp/Actors.tsx)
assets.operation: drawn (procedural SVG from 3-D joints), paws placed by the gait solver in build/solve.ts

assets.what: porch, façade, door, room, lamp, railing, sky, trees, stars, moon (build/src/comp/World.tsx)
assets.operation: drawn; trees/stars/board ends placed with Remotion random() seeds

assets.what: doorway light spill and the cast shadows (build/src/lib/light.ts)
voice (formant synthesis), paws, body, sighs, tail thumps, door creak, wind, crickets, room hum and clock
Big Shoulders Display 800, JetBrains Mono 400, Literata 400 italic/regular (woff2)
assets.rights: SIL Open Font License 1.1 (all three families are OFL Google Fonts)
assets.operation: copied into build/cache/public/fonts, loaded with FontFace + delayRender
